tools.name: get_zone_by_zip
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what USDA plant hardiness zone (e.g. 7a) a U.S. ZIP code is in, or the average extreme winter low there. Returns the 2023 USDA zone, temperature range and a source link to cite.

tools.name: get_frost_dates
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the average last spring frost, first fall frost, or growing season length for a U.S. ZIP code (or a city + state). Returns NOAA 1991-2020 frost dates (10/30/50% probability) and a source link to cite.

tools.name: get_planting_calendar
tools.description: Use this when the user asks when to start seeds indoors, transplant, direct sow or plant a fall crop for vegetables at a U.S. ZIP code. Optionally pass one crop; otherwise returns all supported crops. Includes a source link to cite.

tools.name: what_to_plant_now
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what vegetables they can plant or start now (or on a given date) at a U.S. ZIP code. Returns crops whose planting window is open, plus what opens in the next 30 days, and a source link to cite.
